summary: Ha et al. report Akkermansia versus PBS within fructose-fed mice, but each reported sequencing effect is specific to a hypothalamic cell type or neuronal subtype. The registered effect combines all deposited cells within each library. The whole-hypothalamus qPCR experiment tests oleoylethanolamide versus vehicle, so it cannot supply the missing treatment effect.

manualReview.summary: Ha et al. report cell-type-specific effects for the fructose arms. The registered whole-hypothalamus contrast has no equivalent author result in the reviewed sources.
manualReview.note: The GEO series archive and family SOFT match the retained source hashes. The registered edgeR-QL fit uses 47,492 deposited cell barcodes summed within six libraries, three fructose controls and three fructose plus Akkermansia. The revised preprint (10.1101/2022.09.06.506855, Fig. 2 and Table S1) identifies three mice per arm and 7,244 post-QC cells across the fructose arms. All 23 Table S1 sheets report results for individual cell types or neuronal subtypes. Figure 6J,K tests hypothalamic expression after oleoylethanolamide administration. The authors' same-treatment qPCR in Fig. 4L measures ileum. Agreement in whole-hypothalamus effects and inference remains unassessed.
reviewFlags: The public record supports the mouse count per arm. Individual cage assignments for the sequenced libraries remain undocumented.
Cell-type-specific sequencing effects have a different biological scope from the registered whole-hypothalamus coefficient.

verificationReview.reason: Both versions of the preprint supply direct gene-level effects for the same treatment direction within cell populations. Neither supplies a gene-level AkkF-versus-PBSF effect across the whole hypothalamus. The GEO sample files contain gene-by-barcode counts, and the whole-hypothalamus qPCR intervention is oleoylethanolamide.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen if an author-issued whole-hypothalamus AkkF-versus-PBSF gene table becomes available with the contributing libraries, cell filtering and effect definition.

computed.value: 15,564 distinct gene symbols from 47,492 deposited barcodes across three fructose-control and three fructose plus Akkermansia libraries.

computed.claim: Fructose-arm cells contributing to the authors’ post-QC single-cell analysis, as reported in the revised manuscript
Scope of the revised Supplemental Table 1
computed.value: All 23 sheets contain cell-type or neuronal-subtype gene-effect rows. Of 13,819 rows across both diets, 7,347 carry an AkkF-versus-PBSF label. These are rows across populations, not a count of distinct genes.
12 sample archives match the family SOFT inventory. Each contains a genes.tsv, a barcodes.tsv and an integer Matrix Market matrix. The series matrix contains zero expression data rows.

openIssues: Agreement for the registered whole-hypothalamus treatment effect remains unassessed. A whole-hypothalamus author table for the fructose arms would permit a new review.
